CA.rationale: Identified content (red) is explicitly paired with a processing/origin condition on the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue positions) and a separate origin/representation entry are present for the same referent/time, providing content (C), organization/access (O) and a separate status-origin distinction (D).

A.rationale: The origin metadata (feedback_through) links a processing/estimation condition to the same content referent's presentation.

C.rationale: Explicitly identifies represented content (color-labeled position sets) for named referents.

D.rationale: The text separates content identification (red/blue sets) from organization/access metadata (origin), distinguishing content from status/representation.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/represented_time entry describes how/when the content representation is organized or accessed.
